title: Kenyan-Style Yogurt Flatbread
description: A simple and delicious flatbread recipe from Kenya, topped with a tangy yogurt sauce. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Cut the flatbread into triangles or rectangles.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
While the flatbread is baking, mix the yogurt with a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Once the flatbread is ready, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a minute or two.
Drizzle the yogurt sauce over the flatbread and top with a drizzle of oozing (such as honey or jam).
